name: GMB Computers Datacenter Constanta
notes: Hosting/VPS/IT provider headquartered in Constanta with data center services (Str. Traian 68A); Data Center Map lists 2 facilities in Constanta; directory/operator-page evidence, no capacity published.

name: Webnet Solutions Datacenter Constanta
notes: Green modular datacenter offering in Constanta (diesel generators, 24/7 monitoring, HVAC); operator marketing page without capacity/address; verify with local records.

name: ClusterPower Mischii Technology Campus (MSC1)
notes: First hyperscale data center campus in Eastern Europe, Mischii (Dolj), launched April 2022 (~EUR 40m); campus designed up to 200 MW / 4,500 racks, PUE 1.1, 25,000 sqm facility; NVIDIA CSP partner; first phase construction began Aug 2021.

name: ClusterPower / AIC 800 MW AI data center region (Mischii + Fauresti)
notes: Dec 2025 announcement: co-develop 800 MW AI data center region across two sites - expanding operational MSC1 in Mischii (3 new phases, >500 MW) plus Fauresti site (Valcea county); needs local permits/grid (Transelectrica/Transgaz) confirmation before upgrade.

name: Orange Business / NCC Balcan-IX Galati
notes: Legacy NCC Balcan-IX data center at Strada Brailei 41, Galati; M&A event 2021 (NCC Balcan-IX into Orange); directory-grade evidence - verify with Orange or local records.

name: Pidgin Host Data Center (Bacu)
notes: Str. Antiaeriana 43C, Bacu, Giurgiu County (about 20 min south of Bucharest); privately-owned DC offering colocation, dedicated servers, cloud, kubernetes; dual feeds, UPS and diesel generators; hosting since 2011.

name: Infinite Chain - Toplita Technology Park
notes: Hyperscale data center complex under development at Zencani (Strada Alunis 19), Toplita, Harghita; company claims 50 MW IT load on 5,400 sqm with lowest PUE/carbon footprint; carrier-neutral with dark fiber; development-stage - needs local permits (AC/ANMAP) confirmation.

name: NXDATA-3 Bucharest (BUH3) - Tunari
notes: 38 Bucharest Ring Road, Tunari, Ilfov; 5 MW total electrical / 3 MW IT power, 2,000 sqm white space in 4 data halls; single-storey purpose-built facility; opening target 2026 (Q4 per methodology) - under development.

name: Microsoft Otopeni land lead
notes: Trade-press reports (2022) of Microsoft land/possible plans near Otopeni, Ilfov; no official Azure region or permit record found (Azure geographies do not list Romania); methodology treats as permit-land lead only - do not count as facility.

name: WhiteHat Bucharest (Rosu, Chiajna)
notes: Strada Rezervelor 72, Rosu (Chiajna commune, Ilfov) - physically Ilfov per address even though marketed as Bucharest; one of WhiteHat's three Romanian DCs; directory-grade evidence.

name: CH-Hosting Chiajna
notes: Colocation facility in Chiajna, Ilfov; directory-grade evidence (Data Center Platform / Data Center Map); verify with operator.

name: DataPark Miroslava
notes: Own data center at Strada Mihail Kogalniceanu 1, Miroslava, Iasi; developed and continuously expanded for 6+ years (19 years of IT infrastructure experience via XTEK Invest); colocation, cloud VDS, backup services.

name: DATA ZYX Drobeta Datacenter
notes: Calea Tg. Jiului 35, Drobeta-Turnu Severin, Mehedinti; carrier-neutral facility with 2N power redundancy per Inflect; 1 network / 1 exchange per PeeringDB; directory-grade evidence.

name: Cloud Maramures county data center
notes: County cloud project announced Jan 2022 by Maramures county council: data center ('Cloud Maramures') to host all county public services and citizen/business interaction; local press (Graiul Maramuresului); verify funding/permit status - may be superseded by NW regional DC in Bistrita.
